title: 3.04 / Typography / Whitney
slide_intent: Give small text its own typographic role so detailed information remains readable beside prominent headlines.
strategic_value: Whitney can carry Spectrum’s supporting information without competing with Gotham’s headline role.
demonstration: A Whitney character specimen sits above paired roman and italic weights from Light to Bold.
practical_value: Choose a body-copy weight while keeping the headline and supporting-text roles distinct.

content_islands.name: Heading and usage notes
content_islands.spec: Set the title upper left and body-copy role above the specimen, with access and fallback notes at upper right.

content_islands.name: Whitney specimen
content_islands.spec: Place a cyan family name above large alphabet, numeral and punctuation lines.

content_islands.name: Weight comparison
content_islands.spec: Align roman and italic weight names in two lower columns.

ingredient.name: Whitney
ingredient.role: Carry body copy and small text.
ingredient.application: Use Whitney for body copy and small text; choose among the displayed weights for hierarchy.
ingredient.scope: 2017 retail guide. Arial Regular and Bold are internal-document fallbacks if Gotham and Whitney are unavailable.
